record_title: Poisson and Gumbel laws for one-flip instability in Gaussian binary MIMO
provenance: A conditional-independence refinement of the Hamming-one maximum-likelihood obstruction yields the exact critical-window Poisson law, its Gumbel local-stability threshold, and a rectangular effective-SNR extension.
limitations: Only Hamming-distance-one competitors are classified; the result does not determine the full lower-order ML recovery threshold. It assumes i.i.d. real Gaussian channels and Gaussian noise with aspect ratio bounded away from zero and infinity. A folklore or near-simultaneous statement remains possible because the motivating preprint is recent and already identifies the same one-bit heuristic window.
